# agentmoney

> Know what your AI costs: pricing and spend for Claude, GPT and Gemini. A CLI, an MCP server, three skills and a
> local proxy that price every call from a cited rate table and report where the money went.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what it does, every command and tool, how it prices, and what not to do
- [README.md](README.md): install, quick start, the pricing tables and the proxy
- [identity/SOUL.md](identity/SOUL.md): Ledger, the agent employee behind it, and its boundaries

## Tools

- [src/index.ts](src/index.ts): the `agentmoney` CLI (calc, estimate, models, proxy, usage, demo, sandbox-run, memory-search)
- [src/mcp-server.ts](src/mcp-server.ts): the `agentmoney-mcp` server and its one tool, `cost_query`
- [src/pricing.ts](src/pricing.ts): the rate table and fuzzy model matching

## Skills

- [skills/cost-investigation/SKILL.md](skills/cost-investigation/SKILL.md): explain a bill by model, session and cache savings
- [skills/add-model-pricing/SKILL.md](skills/add-model-pricing/SKILL.md): add or change a rate in the table, the README and a test
- [skills/isolate-untrusted-pricing/SKILL.md](skills/isolate-untrusted-pricing/SKILL.md): price a call log you did not write inside an E2B sandbox

## Sub-agents and hooks

- [.claude/agents/cost-analyst.md](.claude/agents/cost-analyst.md): explains where spend went
- [.claude/agents/pricing-curator.md](.claude/agents/pricing-curator.md): checks rates against the providers and proposes edits
- [hooks/hooks.json](hooks/hooks.json): the SessionStart hook that sums a project's call log

## Self-improvement

- [dsip.json](dsip.json): the self-improvement contract (level L2)
- [eval/README.md](eval/README.md): the evals that gate every change
- [scripts/improve.mjs](scripts/improve.mjs): the nightly loop that writes proposals
- [memory/MEMORY.md](memory/MEMORY.md): long-term memory index
- [memory/LEARNINGS.md](memory/LEARNINGS.md): every correction, turned into a rule
